messages:
Leah (PM): Heads-up 1: Prospect 'Helio Labs' asked for a cheap 'lite' tier to match a rival's low-cost offering. They want a quick pilot. Need to decide minimal scope vs parity.
Arjun (Eng): Minimal parity is doable if we limit to small-batch chat workloads and pick an existing quantized model. Full feature parity (their custom kernel + edge caching) is a no-go in the short term.
Sofia (CS): Helio's ask = price first, acceptable latency up to ~300ms p99 for <64 token responses. They'll provide sample prompts.
Kai (Sales): They want a 6-week pilot window and a simple SLA: p99 under 300ms, and cost < target. They can stretch the timeline slightly if the acceptance criteria are clear.
Noah (Design): UX suggestion: no new endpoints. Add optional header `X-Redwood-Tier: lite` or a boolean flag in dashboard. Keep docs tiny.
Arjun (Eng): Proposed MVP implementation:
- Add model_variant: "lite-8bit" (reuse quantized artifacts)
- Route-level tier mapping that chooses lighter batching and aggressive cache eviction
- Tenant-scoped canary routing for Helio
This avoids touching core runtime batching logic.
Jules (Legal): Pilot pricing fine but need clearance on removal of some telemetry for privacy. Also require explicit acceptance test agreement.
sre-bot: Note: New tier impacts autoscaler heuristics. SRE review required; recommend region-limited canary and a runbook.
Leah (PM): Launch/acceptance checklist proposal:
1) Spike validates perf for lite-8bit (target p99 <= 300ms for sample set)
2) CS obtains Helio eval set and signs off on <=10% quality delta
3) Docs + SDK flag + quickstart
4) SRE sign-off + runbook + rollback plan
5) Legal approves pilot contract
Arjun (Eng): Rough effort: spike (3 days), core routing + model_variant (2 sprints), infra/autoscaler changes (1 sprint), docs+QA (1 sprint). With parallel work we can hit 6 weeks.
Sofia (CS): I'll request the Helio prompt set and ask them to mark priority use-cases. We need acceptance thresholds in writing.
Kai (Sales): I'll get pricing target from them and draft the pilot term sheet contingent on CS acceptance criteria.
Noah (Design): API minimal change = optional header. I'll mock docs and banner copy.
Jules (Legal): I'll draft a one-page acceptance appendix for the pilot (eval set, threshold, rollback).
Leah (PM): Decision: greenlight a Helio-only pilot using the lightweight approach (model_variant + tier routing) if SRE and Legal sign-off and CS has the eval set. Goal: first production canary in 6 weeks.
Arjun (Eng): I'll start the spike tomorrow and create tickets. If the spike shows >30% regression we stop.
Sofia (CS): On it 1. I'll have the first prompt upload request out today.
Kai (Sales): I'll push to get the commercial terms done this afternoon.
sre-bot: Canary scheduled post-SRE review; will require region limit and throttles.
Leah (PM): Thanks team. We'll reconvene in 48 hours with spike status and legal note. React with :thumbsup: if you agree or speak up now.
